scope: Scoped TaskError recovery in mixed CPU/GPU main using completed parallel/await results and the existing bounded TaskCore.

semantics.results: Bare parallel and await return completed expected-error results. Bind for later handling, try or catch. Numeric uses and discarded errors reject compilation.
semantics.settlement: try in a block fails its group and exits through close/join. Catch runs only after descendants and external GPU completions settle. Success skips the handler.
semantics.fault_boundary: Child faults become settled TaskError.Fault. Faults in direct supervisor execution and external cancellation of the owning invocation remain terminal.
semantics.groups: Catching an individual await cannot heal its containing failed group. Catch the completed parallel result to continue in a healthy enclosing scope.
semantics.propagation: Handler-local try/fail produce an expected error for a later catch/try. Task::fail preserves variant, code and source location; invalid tags fault; existing invocation fault/cancellation takes precedence.
semantics.matching: Exhaustive TaskError/FaultKind cases, duplicate/unreachable validation, typed kind/message/reason fields and lexical pattern bindings. Diagnostic text has no new string operations.
semantics.branches: Common float32 scalar/rank-one/rank-two tensor success type and matching residency/device. Differing inferred axes become dynamic; explicit surrounding constraints and downstream guards remain effective.
semantics.ownership: Scalar copies or immutable Buffer lease copies, with no tensor payload copy or implicit transfer from catch. Branch-local tasks/errors must be handled on their path; conditional handling alone does not discharge ancestor obligations.
semantics.admission_race: If a group fails and settles between argument evaluation and admission, an empty admission handle now preserves that group failure and exits through settlement rather than faulting Invalid.
semantics.limits: Mixed main still requires one outer try parallel and an actual GPU call. No asynchronous CPU helper bodies, broader values, new numeric types or shared placement-aware task/residency IR.

coverage: GPU work before protected CPU child shape failure, typed fallback, GPU work after recovery
Ten supervisor CPU allocation failures with 1/2/4 workers
Scope cancellation/deadline recovery after yielding to force maintenance before subsequent admission
Held GPU compute failure recovers and executes subsequent GPU work
AdmissionRejected propagated without Fault conversion when the later fallback cannot admit work
Four non-success variants preserve code, line and column
None and out-of-range tags become Invalid faults
Existing invocation allocation fault and its location override supplied propagated error

runtime_faults: Direct fault in selected handler remains terminal
Branch-dependent final tensor shape is guarded after recovery

compiler_asan_ubsan: Sanitized compiler generated the recovery source fixture successfully.
distributed_execution: Not implemented; design-review gate retained in docs/roadmap.md.
performance: Control-flow and correctness integration; no speedup claim.
